task: Phase 2 task 008 (in-flight): per-segment char_count + final 'failed' phase in active_segments_map

app/orchestration/tasks/segment_synthesi.summary: ChapterSynthesisTask._on_child_segment_tick gains a 'final' kwarg; a final failed tick now WRITES a phase='failed' active_segments_map entry (was: always popped) with progress/eta_seconds, distinguishing a genuinely-exhausted-retry failure from a non-final in-progress failure tick (which still pops). New _segment_char_count(segment_id) helper looks up a segment's OWN char count from self._children's group segments (never the render-group's combined text_length, per R-G/no-fabrication). Every active_segments_map entry (done/failed/in-progress) now carries a best-effort char_count when resolvable. The as_completed loop's terminal call now passes final=True so only the authoritative post-retry outcome can write 'failed'.

flow_impact: active_segments_map entries (consumed by useStudioChapter.ts and, once task 008 finishes wiring the Activity page, ActivityPage.tsx) gain char_count and a real 'failed' phase value; downstream consumers that assume only 'preparing'|'rendering'|'done' should be updated to handle 'failed' (types/index.ts ActiveSegmentMapEntry — task 008 in progress).
